object_entity.description: A single bishop holds authority over the local Christian community as representative of God.

passage.notes: Bishop as representative of God; threefold ministry with explicit apostolic correspondence

passage.notes: Threefold ministry required for valid church; bishop as Christ, presbyters as apostles
